Synopsis:
Player and Astarion-companion get attacked by a group of vampire spawns during the night.

Cluster Contexts:
- CAMP_VampireAmbush_SCO_Companion.json: You and Astarion were set upon at night by a pack of vampire spawns — attackers tied to Astarion’s past rather than random monsters. The player already knows (or has just learned) that Astarion is a vampire spawn and that many of these creatures are effectively his “family,” likely made or controlled by his old master, Cazador. Earlier banter implies the player joked about letting Astarion be taken, and the two of you managed to beat the attackers, though the situation is messy. Now the player considers trying to save the captured spawns, while Astarion responds with bitter cynicism, convinced the victims have grown attached to their torturer and aren’t worth rescuing.
- CAMP_AstarionHungerC_CRD_Astarion_MorningAfter.json: You wake up the morning after the night where Astarion (companion) tried to bite you. Depending on your choices, he might have bitten you consensually or you might have told him to piss off. He'll be wary to see if you're still in a forgiving mood. The other companions chime in with their opinions on having a vampire around, and the player defends keeping Astarion in the party.
- END_GameFinale_ROM_RomanceFates_Astarion.json: Astarion and the player he's in a romantic relationship with talk in a private bedroom in an inn, the morning after spending the night together after saving the world. A discussion of what comes next ensues, varying depending on how Astarion's story unfolded. He could:- Have killed Cazador and taken power to become the Vampire Ascendant.- Have killed Cazador and stayed a spawn (with reactivity to whether or not he killed the Spawn Prisoners.)- Not killed Cazador.
- Astarion_InParty2_Nested_BlackMassFollowUp.json: Section of the Astarion's In Party dialog where we discuss the aftermath of the Black Mass Ritual (Astarion became vampire lord or stayed vampire spawn, possible romance/friendship discussions)
- Astarion_InParty2_Nested_KilledYou.json: Astarion killed you during the camp night where he bit you.When you talk to him in the morning he tells you he was worried about you.
